evidence: Changes src/rpc/blockchain.cpp to acquire cs_main in getblockheader and getchaintxstats.
rationale: Resolves data races in getblockheader and getchaintxstats by locking cs_main when reading block index transaction counts. The change prevents undefined behavior and torn reads during concurrent block downloads or AssumeUTXO validation, but introduces minor lock contention on cs_main in high-throughput RPC paths.
